summary: Fremont NF lookout site, Lake County: 10-foot timber tower built 1952, staffed into 1961, removed 1972; a 2007 photo caption shows only remains.

facts.design: 10-foot treated timber L-4 tower with a hip-roof Aladdin lookout house
facts.status_note: Lookout removed in 1972. A July 2007 photo caption on peakbagging.com says it is all that remains of the 1952 lookout.

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to visitors, or describes its condition today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1972 and firelookout.com says destroyed that year. Both mean the tower is gone, so the record's status 'gone' stands.
The register, FFLOS and a 1959 inspection give 10 feet (about 3 m). A 1963 memo calls it a 20-foot wood tower. The record keeps 3.0 m, which the register and 1959 inspection support.

notes_for_editor: History is well sourced from the register and the Forest Lookouts history. Current access and condition: not found. Coordinates: the record (42.07431, -120.24402) matches FFLOS and firelookout.com. A second internal dataset gives 42.06266, -120.24079, about 1.3 km south and slightly east; FFLOS says the lookout stood a mile north of the summit, so the two points may differ for that reason. Not resolved. Staff names are from 1959-1961 Herald and News notices as quoted by Forest Lookouts; not checked against the newspaper. Photos: none added (credits are courtesy-only).
